actions.command: /bin/zsh -c "cat tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json pnpm-workspace.yaml package.json packages-private/tsconfig.json; rg -n 'ShallowRef|@vue/|\"vue\"' packages/*/src packages-private/*/src -g '*.ts' -g '*.vue' -g '*.tsx'"

/bin/zsh -c "rg -n 'ShallowRef' packages packages-private -g '"'!*.md'"'; ls node_modules; cat packages/reactivity/package.json packages/runtime-core/package.json; rg -n 'export \\*|ShallowRef' packages/*/src/index.ts packages/*/src/*runtime*.ts packages/vue-compat/src/esm-index.ts; cat packages-private/vite-debug/tsconfig.json"

/bin/zsh -c "node --input-type=commonjs <<'NODE'
const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),ts=require('typescript');const parsed=ts.parseJsonConfigFileContent(ts.readConfigFile('tsconfig.json',ts.sys.readFile).config,ts.sys,'.');const prog=ts.createProgram(parsed.fileNames,parsed.options),c=prog.getTypeChecker();const sf=prog.getSourceFile('packages/reactivity/src/ref.ts'); const target=c.getSymbolAtLocation(sf.statements.find(x=>ts.isTypeAliasDeclaration(x)&&x.name.text==='ShallowRef').name);
for(const sf of prog.getSourceFiles()){const f=p.relative('.',p.resolve(sf.fileName));if("'!/''^packages(?:-private)?'"\\/["'^/]+'"\\/src\\//.test(f)||sf.isDeclarationFile||f.startsWith('packages/reactivity/'))continue;let hits=[];function visit(n){if(ts.isIdentifier(n)){let s=c.getSymbolAtLocation(n);if(s?.flags&ts.SymbolFlags.Alias)s=c.getAliasedSymbol(s);if(s===target)hits.push({line:sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(n.getStart()).line+1,text:n.text,kind:ts.SyntaxKind[n.parent.kind]});}if(ts.isExportDeclaration(n)&&n.moduleSpecifier&&"'!n.exportClause){const m=c.getSymbolAtLocation(n.moduleSpecifier);let x=m&&c.getExportsOfModule(m).find(s=>s.name==='"'ShallowRef');if(x?.flags&ts.SymbolFlags.Alias)x=c.getAliasedSymbol(x);if(x===target)hits.push({line:sf.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(n.getStart()).line+1,text:n.getText(sf),kind:'STAR'});}ts.forEachChild(n,visit);}visit(sf);if(hits.length)console.log(f,JSON.stringify(hits));}
NODE
nl -ba packages/runtime-core/src/index.ts | sed -n '195,225p'
nl -ba packages/runtime-core/src/customFormatter.ts | sed -n '187,199p'
rg -n '\"(check|test-unit|build)\"' package.json"

/bin/zsh -c "cat node_modules/.pnpm/estree-walker@2.0.2/node_modules/estree-walker/package.json node_modules/.pnpm/rollup@4.25.0/node_modules/rollup/package.json; ls node_modules/.pnpm/estree-walker@2.0.2/node_modules; rg -n '"'^  packages|vue:|version: link:'"' pnpm-lock.yaml | head -90"
